questions.question: God told Jeremiah to write His warnings of coming calamity for Judah on a scroll. What did God hope each person would do?
When Jehudi read Jeremiah's scroll to King Jehoiakim, what did the king do after every few columns?

answers.text: Cut them off and threw them in the fire
Handed them to an official to keep
Told Jehudi to read them once more

questions.question: King Jehoiakim sent men to seize Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet. Who had hidden the two men?
After King Jehoiakim burned Jeremiah's scroll, what did the LORD tell Jeremiah to do?

answers.text: Write the very same words on another scroll
Stop speaking to the king for good
Leave Jerusalem with Baruch at once
